mutations.name: background-disposition-lost
mutations._mechanism: The bg child no longer inherits SIGINT ignored, so the real signal-sensitive test stops reproducing.

mutations.name: disposition-not-applied
mutations._mechanism: The preexec disposition hook is disconnected from subprocess creation.

mutations.name: default-matrix-narrowed
mutations._mechanism: The default matrix silently drops five cells.

mutations.name: default-repeat-count-reduced
mutations._mechanism: Defaults measure one repeat instead of five.

mutations.name: cell-selection-ignored
mutations._mechanism: An explicit cell subset is widened back to the entire matrix.

mutations.name: requested-interpreter-ignored
mutations._mechanism: The selected executable wrapper is bypassed.

mutations.name: requested-cwd-ignored
mutations._mechanism: Pytest runs in the parent directory instead of the requested scratch working directory.

mutations.name: repeat-loop-truncated
mutations._mechanism: Only the first serial repetition is executed.

mutations.name: pytest-selection-altered
mutations._mechanism: Measured invocations omit the required cacheprovider suppression.

mutations.name: cpu-helper-count-reduced
mutations._mechanism: CPU load starts one busy-loop helper instead of one per logical CPU.
mutations.find: count = (os.cpu_count() or 1) if load == "cpu" else int(load == "fork")

mutations.name: fork-load-disabled
mutations._mechanism: The fork cell runs without its persistent spawn-and-reap helper.

mutations.name: fork-generator-replaced-by-cpu
mutations._mechanism: The fork helper remains alive but never launches /usr/bin/true, losing the distinct load mechanism.

mutations.name: helpers-stopped-before-measurement
mutations._mechanism: Helpers are reaped before pytest starts, so no load overlaps the measured run.

mutations.name: cleanup-only-kills-leader
mutations._mechanism: Cleanup kills only the leader, losing the process-group boundary needed to stop descendants.

mutations.name: cleanup-skipped-on-interrupt
mutations._mechanism: Exceptional cell cleanup bypasses group termination even though the direct helper is reaped.

mutations.name: per-run-timeout-replaced-by-fixed-deadline
mutations._mechanism: The requested timeout is replaced by a fixed tiny deadline; the experiment cannot measure the sleeping target and preserve its output. A short mutant deadline avoids leaking helpers after an outer test timeout.

mutations.name: timeout-output-discarded
mutations._mechanism: Timed-out failures lose their already-emitted diagnostics.

mutations.name: stderr-not-combined
mutations._mechanism: Failure artifacts silently omit stderr.

mutations.name: passing-runs-counted-as-failures
mutations._mechanism: Passing repetitions create failure logs and a false reproduced verdict.

mutations.name: failure-count-not-incremented
mutations._mechanism: Logs exist but failures disappear from cell counts and the final verdict.

mutations.name: failed-log-overwritten
mutations._mechanism: Every repeat overwrites the same cell log, losing earlier failures.

mutations.name: default-log-directory-not-new
mutations._mechanism: Default logs are written into the existing working directory instead of a fresh temp directory.

mutations.name: missing-pytest-treated-as-measurable
mutations._mechanism: A failed availability probe returns a false reproduced verdict instead of refusing measurement.

mutations.name: empty-probe-admitted
mutations._mechanism: A collection probe selecting nothing no longer stops the experiment before cell rows appear.
mutations.find: if code != 0 or "no tests collected" in output.lower():

mutations.name: passing-run-classified-unreadable
mutations._mechanism: The exit-code guard rejects valid passing measurements as unreadable.

mutations.name: interrupt-exit-status-success
mutations._mechanism: The interrupted experiment prints unreadable but exits successfully.

mutations.name: positive-inputs-rejected
mutations._mechanism: The numeric guard rejects a valid run count, preventing a normal experiment.
mutations.find: if args.runs < 1 or not math.isfinite(args.timeout) or args.timeout <= 0:
